exact_public_header:
theorem retained_coordinate_isReversible
    {A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B]
    (μ : Measure A) [SFinite μ]
    (R : Kernel A B) [IsSFiniteKernel R]
    (F : Kernel (A × B) B) [IsSFiniteKernel F]
    (hF : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, (F.comap (fun b => (a, b))
      (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).IsReversible (R a)) :
    ((Kernel.deterministic Prod.fst measurable_fst) ×ₖ F).IsReversible (μ ⊗ₘ R)

binder_audit: TYPING: arbitrary measurable A and B; no topology, StandardBorel, measurable singletons or nonempty hypothesis.

API/MATHEMATICAL SCOPE: SFinite mu and s-finite R,F make the pinned compProd/product meaningful. They are not claimed logically necessary for every independently defined extension; do not exploit totalized zero kernels outside this scope.

MATHEMATICAL: for mu-a.e. a, the jointly measurable F restricted to the fiber is reversible under R(a). This is simultaneous measurable-set detailed balance. The a.e. good set needs no separate measurability certificate.
No Markovness, probability/finite mass, sigma-finiteness, integrability, support or normalized conditional law is supplied. Infinite fluxes, zero measures/fibers and empty spaces are allowed.
